policy: Error analysis and experiment design use dev failures only; holdout results are read in aggregate (report.md and the console show them by split, never per case, unless --reveal-holdout). Any change to the holdout (a case added, removed or changed) requires rewriting this manifest with a dated note (npm run holdout-manifest -- --write --note "...").

history.note: Holdout retired after the Experiment 1 error analysis inspected it: its 81 cases (45 intents) are dev now, tagged formerly_holdout. Empty until the fresh holdout, authored blind, is added.

Fresh holdout (v2) added: datasets/holdout-public.json, 149 cases (147 answer, 2 abstain) over 77 intents, authored blind on eval/holdout-v2-authoring after the retired holdout became dev; frozen as authored.

2026-10-06: gold corrected after an independent two-annotator audit (no model outputs inspected): all 147 answer cases audited, 10 cases (6 intents) changed, none dropped. Gold fix (2 cases): largest_open_items_top5 now lists only documents with an unpaid balance (d.BalanceAmount > 0), so seed returns 3 rows, not 5 padded with paid documents; this subsumes the proposed positive-balance alternative on 599841. Every-member alternatives (6 cases): store_mar_vs_apr_2026 (every store), customer_paid_vs_open_q1_2026 (every customer, plus null_as_zero on paid_amount/open_balance) and category_h1_vs_h2_2025 (every category), as the pivot / 'for each' convention allows. Rewordings (2 cases, new ids): documents_last_7_days 8ee6c9 -> 8ca4d2 ('How many documents ...') and campaign_units_by_store 144980 -> 12ee7a ('... for the campaign and outlet combinations that had sales'). Pins re-written on fresh fixtures; controls regenerated (design kill 779/779, positives 23/23).

2026-10-06: fingerprint scheme change, no holdout case changed. The manifest fingerprint now covers every field the check compares (id, question, gold and scoring fingerprints, intentId and datasets); before, intentId and datasets were compared but not hashed, so a change to them could not get a note. Entries are identical to the previous state.

2026-10-06: fingerprint scheme change, no holdout case changed. Each entry gains measurement_fingerprint (split, expected_behavior, known_validator_rejection, expected_tables, failure_class, difficulty, tags), which the check compares and the manifest fingerprint covers, so a change that moves failures between attribution buckets or report breakdowns (for example a known_validator_rejection flag) needs a dated note. The scoring fingerprint, which comparisons pair cases on, is unchanged.

2026-10-07: fingerprint scheme extended; no case definition changed. Manifest version 2: each entry gains definition_fingerprint, the fingerprint of the whole case definition as the suite compares definitions (caseDefinitionFingerprint: question, canonical question, gold, alternatives, comparison spec, expected behaviour, split, known_validator_rejection, expected_row_counts, signal_checks, intentId, tags, expected tables and columns, disallowed_columns, difficulty, failure class; free-text notes are editorial and left out) with the gold and alternative SQL also compared inside quoted literals (whitespace there is part of a value), and controls_fingerprint, the oracle controls verify-dataset applies to the case (each control's id, type, held-out and validator flags and SQL; control notes are editorial), null for a case without controls. The check compares both and the manifest fingerprint covers them, so editing a holdout case's expected_row_counts, signal_checks, disallowed_columns or controls now needs a dated note too. Every other fingerprint is as before, and the holdout case definitions and their controls are byte-identical to those of e8403d0 (test/holdout-manifest.test.js checks both).
